name: them-one-to-one-no-calendar
description: No voices told apart and no calendar: a 1:1 call where you thank the other person by name.
lines: Hi Sam, thanks for calling back.
No problem, I saw your email about the contract renewal.
Yes, we'd like to renew but at a lower volume this year.
That should be fine, I'll need the new numbers by the end of the month.
Great, thanks Sam, I'll send them over today.
